description: Generated UTDK provider client for Drive API. Manages files in Drive including uploading, downloading, searching, detecting changes, and updating sharing permissions.

scopes.https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive: See, edit, create, and delete all of your Google Drive files
scopes.https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.ap: See, create, and delete its own configuration data in your Google Drive
scopes.https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.fi: See, edit, create, and delete only the specific Google Drive files you use with this app
scopes.https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.me: View and manage metadata of files in your Google Drive
See information about your Google Drive files
scopes.https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.ph: View the photos, videos and albums in your Google Photos
scopes.https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.re: See and download all your Google Drive files
scopes.https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.sc: Modify your Google Apps Script scripts' behavior
